title: Musicians on the European tour
summary: He played with John Letterman and Wallace Bishop, who he says played as if in 1930.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: When you went to Europe with Milt Buckner the first time did you go there with other musicians? Did you play with any European musicians?
Yeah, we had John Letterman, trumpet and a drummer over there...
...He never did progress, as you might say. Boy, he played like he was playin' in 1930. I shouldn't say that...
